answer.narration:
You slap at the release, but your palm skids off the panel. Vasko's distracted second ends in a flat, ugly thunk: the bolt gun fires into the panel beside your hand. Sparks spray. Fragments of hot plastic sting your knuckles, and his elbow catches your ribs on the way down.

The panel dies with a whine. The airlock is fused shut.

Outside, the pounding stops. A new sound starts: the low hiss of a cutting torch biting into the outer hatch. A glowing orange line creeps across the metal.

Vasko reloads, breathing hard. "Ten minutes before they're through," he mutters. "Get up and fly, or get out of my way."

From the hold, the voices have gone quiet, listening.
choices: Head for the hold and free them
Pretend to obey, steer toward the cutter
answer.summary: Waren Spacefarer, a young pilot with ten credits, wants forty thousand to buy the Kestrel from Marta Okafor. He took a no-questions relief pilot job on the ore tug Grubstake for Captain Dren Vasko, promised six hundred credits on delivery to Vesta. Vasko is smuggling people in the sealed hold. When Ceres Customs ordered an inspection, Waren tried to comply; Vasko punched him. Customs docked; Waren tried to open the airlock, but Vasko shot the panel with a cargo bolt gun, fusing the hatch. Customs is now cutting through, about ten minutes out. Vasko orders Waren to fly or get out of the way.
